text:
sara: CI on main is red, failing on scheduler/test_tick_order in two matrix axes (linux-2, windows-3). Looks flaky — can someone retrigger just the failing axes?
ben: saw that. We shouldn't do a full pipeline if only the matrix axes are busted. Which job ids are they?
sara: job urls: https://ci.internal/runs/5678 and https://ci.internal/runs/5682 (matrix indices 2 and 3).
ci-bot: hint: you can retrigger a subset with `@ci-bot rerun --jobs 5678,5682` or use `github`/`buildkite` ui to rerun specific jobs.
matt: if we use GH Actions: `gh run view 123456 --log` to inspect and `gh run rerun --job 7890` to rerun a single job. For our infra the ci-bot command is easiest.
olivia: quick note — test history shows this test fails ~1% on windows frequently after the scheduler refactor. If it flakes again, let's mark it flaky in pytest to avoid noise and file a follow-up to root cause.
sara: trying `@ci-bot rerun --jobs 5678,5682` now
ci-bot: accepted. queued reruns for jobs 5678, 5682. status: queued -> running.
julia: if rerun lands red again, prefer `--no-rebuild` option (re-run step without rebuilding artifacts) to save time: `@ci-bot rerun --jobs 5678 --no-rebuild`. That will reuse the same build if applicable.
ben: good call. We have a `--no-rebuild` flag but it's conditional (only for the same commit/hash). Otherwise it falls back to full build.
matt: logs from rerun 5678: ```
FAILED tests/scheduler/test_tick_order.py::test_out_of_order
AssertionError: expected 3 got 4
--- stack ---
  File "tests/scheduler/test_tick_order.py", line 42, in test_out_of_order
```
sara: rerun 5682 passed, 5678 still failing. I'm going to mark 5678 flaky and open a tiny PR to add xfail with a TODO.
olivia: can you also add a short note in the rerun channel when you xfail? helps triage when flakes pile up. :memo: 
sara: will do — filing PR now, pinging @qa for follow-up.
ben: one more tip — if you want to bisect which commit introduced flakiness across a range, use `ci-bot bisect --job 5678 --range 2026-01-01..2026-02-15`. It automates a bisection run. Use only when flake is persistent.
sara: thanks all, reruns handled. marking slack thread as resolved after PR merges. :white_check_mark:
